# Solving Club Client Management System

Solving Club is a secure client delivery workspace for managing clients, projects, applications, tasks, discussions, shared documents, invoices, and client portal access.

## Product areas

- Dashboard: delivery health, attention queue, and client load.
- Clients: relationship workspaces with project, files, billing, and access details.
- Projects: dedicated project workspaces and application management.
- Applications: focused delivery task workspaces with discussions and task files.
- All work: cross-client delivery command center with live filters.

Authentication is required for application data. Client accounts only access their own workspace.
